title: Stone of Matter — Ep. 2 Darkness
logline: A light being seeds a young world against the dark, and thousands of years later a boy who can hear the wind learns that the dark has four of the seven stones and is coming for the fifth.

higgsfield._: Created from the desk with create_project(surface=cinematic_studio). The root is the only folder so far; make scene subfolders at Gate B and record them here. 'AI Film Festival 2' (93a4a8a7…) is a different film and is not this project. The image model moved to Cinema Studio Image 2.5 on Oct 5 (2 credits a 2K still at 21:9, takes reference elements); video is Cinema Studio 4.0 (56 credits for 8s at 720p, 96 at 1080p; model audio is on unless generate_audio is false).

lock.rule: Every generation and remix for SoM V2 (stills, video, start- and end-frame animations, reference remixes, edits and extensions) is filed into this project's folder and nowhere else. Claude passes folder_id on every call; the studio refuses to submit unless its folder matches this lock; generate.py refuses, because the Cloud API cannot file into a project folder.

inherits._: What a sequel takes from the previous film by id, so nothing is re-described. Elements listed here are attached with their Episode 1 ids; the Souls are reachable if a face recurs.
inherits.read: anchorframe/projects/matter-of-light/project.json → final, and workflow.json → stage 8 (Learn): the delivered film ran 100 scenes at 3.7s against a 23-shot board; cuts landed on lyrics; five costume states of the lead reached the jury; the Predictor refused 16s renders; two silent regenerations came back with phantom speech; a wide read adults as children.
lessons_applied: Every shot is 16s or under, and the 16s set pieces (S1, S5, S11, S18, S22, S23) get a 15s take too, so the Predictor can score them.
Audio is off on every silent shot (15 of 26) so the model cannot add speech; the tail of every audio-on take is soloed at Gate E.
Each set piece names its B lane in `notes`; generate it before Gate D. Montage shots are 8–12s because the cut will run short.
The middle cue is diegetic and its lyrics are the screenplay's own, so the board is written to the song instead of discovering it in the cut (tip 32).
One Soul per face before any shot — Ammon and Sadie first. No second design of a lead reaches the board.

Every sheet says 18+ and every wide with a figure in it is read back through the analyser before delivery (tip 34). Matteo is sixteen in the source; the sheet renders him as a young man and S21–S22 keep him in storm light.
No packshot and no title card inside a generated shot; the end card is editorial.
The continuity audit runs on the timeline at Gate E, not on the board.

characters.bastion: Ammon's best friend, big, gentle, a zoo-keeper's hands; lantern in one hand.
characters.sadie: A young woman the same age as Ammon, daughter of Guardian Iceland: blonde hair, a sassy smile, calm eyes; two states: in the crowd at the Wind Caves, in the water at the Lake of Light.
characters.viola: The singer at the Wind Caves, hands out, lantern-lit from below.
characters.vothek: The storyteller: a man with a serious face and playful eyes, on a small stage by a rock wall, firelight.
characters.matteo: A young man (rendered as 18+) with long brown hair whipped by storm wind, bare feet on sacred sand; second state: kneeling in the Outer Darkness as 'Conqueror'.
characters.venetia: The Prison of Voids: a woman who becomes a panther with wrong angles; both states on one sheet; a smell of decay you can see in the air around her.
characters.morningstar: The master of the Outer Darkness: tall, still, lit only by what others give off; no horns, no cliché — a figure whose stillness is the threat.

environments.plate-stardust: The key light of Movement I: pure white light in black, with a violet edge. Every prologue frame inherits it.
environments.abyss-of-four-waterfalls: A drained, colourless land centred on an abyss darker than black; four waterfalls pour in from pure sources on the rim; everything around it dead. Three views: from the air, from the rim, from inside facing one waterfall.
environments.cloud-mountain: A mountain peak above a crater lake that reflects the whole mountain (Mirror Lake), dawn mist — the place Episode 1 ended.
environments.high-forest-lantern-path: Night path between enormous trunks, lantern light sliding up the bark, a glow of the Leviticum through the trees.
environments.wind-caves-stage: A stage in the mouth of a cave, lanterns and fire, ledges for the crowd, the wind audible in the rock; lit from below.
environments.lake-of-light: Translucent water with suspended limestone motes and glowing insects (blue-green), trees anchored in the lake with high roots, a small stage against the rock wall of the North Hills; moonlight. Views: from the trees, from the water, from under it.
environments.old-lands: The ancient world of the Angel Killer legend, day, painted light, a bare rock — warmer and softer than the rest of the film.
environments.leviticum-exterior: A seven-floor circular library of stone and glass above the forest, candles in every window, steps up to main doors with a band of gold inscription (illegible) above them.
environments.leviticum-study-room: A small study room: foam mattresses, books, a glisc projector throwing constellations on the ceiling, very low light.
environments.leviticum-elevator: A glass elevator in a stone shaft; a glowing green call button; numbered buttons where only the 1 glows; the seventh-floor hall beyond the doors, dark.
environments.leviticum-corridor: The ground-floor corridor, lantern-lit, a passage at the end.
environments.ilan-storm: A hidden island at night as a storm tears it apart: sacred sand, a blackened tree, a giant glowing beast in the sky; two lights in the sky, violet and emerald.
environments.outer-darkness: A place with no light; a ring of twelve kneeling figures; the only light is what the bodies and the Stone give off.

props.lantern: A Levitian lantern: brass and glass, warm flame; the same lantern on the forest path and in Master Lyon's hand.
props.ammons-guitar: A worn acoustic guitar, plain wood, one scratch on the lower bout.
props.glisc-projector: A floor-set projector that throws shifting constellations on a ceiling.
props.heart-of-ilan: A jagged, unrefined emerald stone, glowing from inside; also seen buried inches in sand.
props.stone-of-energy: A stone of white-violet light seated in a woman's chest, blasting power outward.

fx.fx-light-wave: Light moving as an ocean wave: cresting over a lip of rock and pouring down over dead land, colour returning in its wake.
fx.fx-wind: A strong wind as it is seen: lantern flames leaning, hair and cloth lifting, dust lifting off a floor.

songs.title: Every Light Casts a Shadow
songs.use: Main title · music video · cue B
songs.theme: Light makes its own shadow, and the shadow can outgrow what made it.
songs.from: Ammon's spoken song at the Wind Caves: “Every light casts a shadow. This shadow, birthed of light, may be the one that finds itself larger than its creator.”
songs.fit: 78–92 BPM. Starts sparse on acoustic or piano, spoken verses, the sung chorus lifts at about 1:05, a darker bridge, the biggest chorus last. The music-video form above is cut to this shape at 3:30.
songs.style: cinematic folk rock, fingerpicked acoustic intro, spoken-word verses, soaring choir chorus, building drums, minor to major lift, 84 bpm
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Spoken Word]
Intelligence is light.
And every light casts a shadow.

[Verse 1]
[Spoken Word]
Before the world there was a word,
a promise spoken into the dark;
every glory, great or small,
was burning from that single spark.
But set a hard heart in the light
and watch the shape it throws:
a shadow born of brightness,
and how the shadow grows.

[Pre-Chorus]
So lift the lantern higher,
don't let it fall behind you...

[Chorus]
Every light casts a shadow,
every shadow knows your name;
the dark was born of brightness,
and it wants the light again.
Hold on to what you're made of,
the sun, the moon, the stars;
every light casts a shadow,
so remember who you are.

[Verse 2]
There's a black seed in the new green ground
where the wave of light came through;
there's a story of a boy who swallowed fire
and the angels that it slew.
The shadow learns to talk like you,
it says you're meant for more,
but the voice that calls you from the storm
is a voice that's lied before.

[Bridge]
Water, Voids, Dominion,
and Energy makes four;
the storm is calling names now,
and it's coming back for more.
Don't answer when it calls you,
don't reach out for its hand;
a shadow needs a light to live,
alone it cannot stand.

[Final Chorus]
Every light casts a shadow,
every shadow knows your name;
the dark was born of brightness,
and it wants the light again.
Hold on to what you're made of,
the sun, the moon, the stars;
every light casts a shadow,
so remember who you are.

[Outro]
[Spoken Word]
Creation began with a single word.
We are one.

songs.title: We Are One
songs.theme: Creation began with one word, and it takes every voice together to say it.
songs.from: “Creation began with a single word… It takes all coming together as one.” The wind answers on the last chord (S12).
songs.fit: 96–112 BPM. A stomp-and-clap or driving acoustic groove, a call-and-response chorus a crowd can sing. Put the wind on the last chord.
songs.style: uplifting folk anthem, driving acoustic guitar, stomps and claps, gang vocals, call and response chorus, big final chord, 104 bpm
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
(hey) (hey)

[Verse 1]
Lanterns in the cave mouth, faces in the glow,
hands that wouldn't settle till the first chord let them go;
I looked for you in all of them, I found you in the crowd,
and every word I'd swallowed started coming out loud.

[Pre-Chorus]
There's a word that no one voice can say,
it takes all of us to say it.

[Chorus]
We are one (we are one),
one word before the world;
we are one (we are one),
every voice and every heart that heard.
Sing it to the rafters, sing it to the stone,
nobody says it on their own:
we are one.

[Verse 2]
They say the wind will call you, and it calls to everyone,
but what it says is only yours, and only when it's done;
mine said hold your fire, yours said trust your true friends,
and every word it ever spoke is where the song begins.

[Pre-Chorus]
There's a word that no one voice can say,
it takes all of us to say it.

[Chorus]
We are one (we are one),
one word before the world;
we are one (we are one),
every voice and every heart that heard.

[Bridge]
And the flames all bowed together
when the last chord hit the air,
and the wind came through the cave mouth
like it had always been there.

[Final Chorus]
We are one (we are one),
one word before the world;
we are one (we are one),
every voice and every heart that heard.
Sing it to the rafters, sing it to the stone,
nobody says it on their own:
we are one.

[Outro]
[Spoken Word]
He is beginning to understand.

songs.title: Seeds of Darkness
songs.use: Prologue · cue A · spot :30 cold open
songs.theme: The light wins the first war and leaves one seed behind.
songs.from: Stardust and Lucille at the abyss of four waterfalls: “Nothing is yours. Nothing will be yours.” “Yet seeds of darkness remain on the planet. It will return.”
songs.fit: 60–76 BPM. An epic trailer build of drones and choir, a duet of a clear high voice and a low whispered one, one huge hit where the light breaks (S5), then quiet.
songs.style: dark epic orchestral, cinematic choir, deep drones, ethereal female lead vocal, whispered low male vocal, massive trailer hits, 68 bpm
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Choir]
Ahh...

[Verse 1]
[Male Vocal, whispered]
Why have you come
to the depths of my power,
to the heart of my land
in my hour?

[Verse 2]
[Female Vocal]
Nothing is yours,
and nothing will be;
you chose to have nothing
for eternity.

[Pre-Chorus]
[Male Vocal]
They will come in their blindness,
we will take them one by one.
[Female Vocal]
Some will follow you willing,
but some will fight for the sun.

[Chorus]
[Choir]
Seeds of darkness in the new green ground,
what the light has buried will come back around;
Proleum, magnificent, what a world you'll be,
but the seed is sleeping where no light can see.
It will return. It will return.

[Instrumental Break]

[Bridge]
[Female Vocal]
Light like an ocean over the edge,
pouring through the valleys, over every ledge;
the cloud falls in, the colour comes home,
and I leave you, little world, to grow on your own.

[Final Chorus]
[Choir]
Seeds of darkness in the new green ground,
what the light has buried will come back around;
Proleum, magnificent, what a world you'll be,
but the seed is sleeping where no light can see.

[Outro]
[Whispered]
It will return.

songs.title: Little Worlds
songs.use: Lake of Light · love theme · second single
songs.theme: Every person is a world with its own sun, moon and stars.
songs.from: The gold inscription over the Leviticum doors: “Remember who you are, within you live true potential. You are all little worlds, within you the Sun, the Moon, the Stars.” The Lake of Light (S14–S16).
songs.fit: 84–100 BPM. Dreamy and buoyant, shimmer and pads, a duet or a lead with soft harmonies; the underwater kiss sits in a hushed breakdown.
songs.style: dreamy indie pop, shimmering synths, soft electric guitar, airy duet vocals, warm bass, gentle beat, hushed breakdown, 92 bpm
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Fireflies are dancing where the old roots meet the shore,
you pulled me through the treeline and I didn't ask what for;
the water's full of starlight, every insect is a spark,
you laughed and took my hand and pulled me further from the dark.

[Pre-Chorus]
They wrote it over the door in gold;
I never knew what it meant till now.

[Chorus]
Remember who you are,
there's a light inside you, a whole world inside you;
we're little worlds
with the sun, the moon, the stars;
remember who you are.

[Verse 2]
Elizabeth is waiting and the music's on the stone,
the storyteller's climbing up, we've got a minute on our own;
you count to three and pull me down where every sound goes blue,
the quietest place I've ever been is underwater next to you.

[Pre-Chorus]
They wrote it over the door in gold;
I never knew what it meant till now.

[Chorus]
Remember who you are,
there's a light inside you, a whole world inside you;
we're little worlds
with the sun, the moon, the stars;
remember who you are.

[Breakdown]
(hushed)
Under the water the world goes quiet,
under the water it's only you.

[Final Chorus]
Remember who you are,
there's a light inside you, a whole world inside you;
we're little worlds, spinning far,
with the sun, the moon, the stars;
remember who you are.

songs.title: Conqueror
songs.use: The dream and the Outer Darkness · cue C · villain theme
songs.theme: A boy is promised everything and gives up his name for it.
songs.from: “You have been chosen by Lord Morning… You are to wield the new stone.” “Matteo is dead. I am now Conqueror.” “Four of the Seven… Seek out the Stones of Matter, Gravity, and Rest.”
songs.fit: Heavy half-time, 130–150 BPM felt at 65–75, distorted low end and a chant hook. Episode 1's metal cue is the template; the hook lands on “Four of the Seven” (S23).
songs.style: dark cinematic metal, heavy half-time riffs, industrial percussion, choir chants, menacing male vocal, storm sound design, 140 bpm
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Spoken Word, low]
Come to me, child.
Accept new power.
You are the one.

[Verse 1]
Storm on the island, rain in my eyes,
a woman in the shadows in a panther's disguise;
she said they're all liars, my family, my friends,
the storm's coming in and the storm makes amends.

[Pre-Chorus]
Violet ate the emerald, the sky went black;
the heart of my island, I'm not giving it back.

[Chorus]
Matteo is dead!
I am Conqueror!
I swallowed the stone and I'm asking for more;
Matteo is dead,
I don't hear him anymore;
I am Conqueror.

[Verse 2]
[Chant]
Four of the seven:
Water, Voids, Dominion, Energy;
four of the seven,
and the rest will come to me.
Matter, Gravity and Rest,
seek them out, don't slow, don't stop;
we kindled once the world in fire,
we'll take it from the top.

[Bridge]
[Female Vocal, whispered]
You'll see your family again,
if you come with me.
[Male Vocal]
I'm doing this for them,
even if it hurts them at first.

[Final Chorus]
Matteo is dead!
I am Conqueror!
I swallowed the stone and I'm asking for more;
Matteo is dead,
I don't hear him anymore;
I am Conqueror.

[Outro]
[Chant]
Do not slow.
Do not be diminished.
Do not let us down.

songs.title: Before They Follow
songs.use: The ending · end credits · bridge to Episode 3
songs.theme: A warning in the dark, and an old man's lantern that says go anyway.
songs.from: The seventh floor: “Leave this place. Leave. Before they follow.” Master Lyon: “Stay true to what you believe is right… where you need to go will become where you want to go.” “Tomorrow is promised to no one.”
songs.fit: 66–80 BPM. A haunting piano or music-box opening, a whispered refrain, strings that warm into hope by the last chorus; it ends unresolved for the next episode.
songs.style: haunting piano ballad, music box, whispered refrain, warm cello and strings build, intimate male vocal, hopeful final chorus, 72 bpm
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Whispered]
Leave this place.
Leave.
Before they follow.

[Verse 1]
I pressed the button for the ground floor and the car began to rise,
only the one was glowing, but the seventh floor arrived;
the glass doors opened on the dark, and something in the hall
had eyes that didn't blink at all.

[Pre-Chorus]
[Whispered]
Leave this place...

[Chorus]
Before they follow,
before they find the door,
I hear the warning in the hollow
and I don't know what it's for;
but there's a lantern on the third floor
and an old man who knows my name;
before they follow,
I'll be ready all the same.

[Verse 2]
He said, I walked here in a dream, and so I came;
he said, your father used to do the same;
he said tomorrow's promised to no one,
so when you feel the prompting, go.

[Bridge]
Stay true to what you know is right,
and every road will lead you home;
where you need to go
becomes where you want to go.

[Final Chorus]
Before they follow,
before they find the door,
I hear the warning in the hollow
and I know now what it's for;
there's a lantern on the third floor
and an old man who knows my name;
before they follow,
I'll be ready all the same.

[Outro]
[Whispered]
A significant day is coming.
Are you prepared?

learned: Start and end frames need mode omni_reference on Cinema Studio 4.0; t2v refuses reference media.
Model audio is on by default (generate_audio true); every take here was made with it off.
The service can answer a generation with a preset suggestion instead of a job (here 'IN THE DARK'); declined_preset_id makes the take as asked, and nothing is charged for the suggestion.
A fist gripping a glowing gem was stopped by the IP check. Show the stone in the sand or the light, not the grip.
No faces are locked yet: Ammon and the others differ from still to still until the Souls and sheets exist.
